How Hodl ranks coins and what it cannot assess

Hodl ranks a selected sample from Snipe's retained pools, new and trending pools on Solana, Base, and Robinhood Chain, and top pools on Solana and Robinhood Chain. It keeps up to 200 ranked contracts per chain. Search an exact Robinhood contract to check the onchain pool catalog when it is outside the ranking sample.

Swing uses current 24-hour turnover, liquidity, sampled one-hour activity and buy share, and available context. Longer-term uses current liquidity and turnover, sampled daily persistence, observed history, and context. These are separate heuristic rankings, not comparable return forecasts.

Samples are taken when the market provider refreshes a coin. They are not a continuous trade tape. Each card shows input coverage; unavailable inputs remain unknown. Market data over 15 minutes old is marked stale. Holder concentration, developer holdings, contract safety, and execution risk are not assessed here. Use Order Flow and external sources before any decision.
